title: 线性有序弦图中边的 Ramsey degree
summary: The narrowed research endpoint is complete. In finite linearly ordered split graphs under induced order-preserving embeddings, the ordered edge has small Ramsey degree exactly 3. The proof includes the marked free-amalgamation upper bound, an explicit forgetful-reduct argument, and the unique-partition ordered P4 lower bound. For all ordered chordal graphs, only the lower bound 2 and exact free/PEO amalgamation obstructions are claimed; the original degree remains open. Referee, novelty, citation, exact-certificate, clean-build, visual-PDF, and extracted-release gates all passed.
exact_result: For the class S_< of finite linearly ordered split graphs with induced order-preserving embeddings, t_{S_<}(K2)=3.
limitations: The exact small Ramsey degree for the full class of ordered chordal graphs is not determined.
For the full chordal class the certified result is only t(K2)>=2, together with exact failures of free amalgamation and amalgamation after naming a PEO.
The novelty conclusion is bounded to the recorded searches through 2026-08-28 and cannot exclude unpublished or differently indexed work.
recommended_continuation: For the original chordal problem, seek an edge-specific partite construction that preserves induced chordality without assuming amalgamation of named PEO expansions.
